en: A colorized interior view of a large museum gallery with tall white columns and a high ceiling fitted with round light fixtures. The room is filled with glass display cases containing natural history dioramas, including taxidermy animals such as a dog and other wildlife set in realistic landscapes. Printed caption text appears along the bottom edge describing the scene, and a small credit line is on the right.
